evidence: List page shows name, cuisine, price tier ($), rating, location, and features for each restaurant (e.g., The Golden Fork: French, $$$$, 4.8, Downtown, Private Dining/Wine Pairing). Detail page /restaurant/1 additionally shows full address, description, and complete feature list (Private Dining, Wine Pairing, Tasting Menu).

Submitting with date/time unset shows toast 'Missing Information: Please fill in all required fields.' Name and Phone inputs have required attribute; Email input has type=email + required, triggering native 'Please include an @ in the email address' validation for invalid format.

Created reservation at Sakura Garden for Aug 27, 2026, 19:00, 2 guests, with contact info. Confirmation toast 'Reservation Confirmed!' shown, and reservation appears in Upcoming (1) list with matching restaurant, date, time, party size, and coupon.

Applied WELCOME10 coupon, saw 'Coupon Applied! 10% off your first reservation' with chip showing '-10% off'; removed it via remove button (chip disappeared, input field returned); reapplied WELCOME10 and submitted reservation. Reservations list shows 'Coupon applied: WELCOME10' on the resulting reservation.

Date picker on restaurant detail page disables all dates through today (Aug 25, 2026) and earlier; dates from Aug 26 onward are selectable. Selecting Aug 27, 2026 (future date) enabled the time dropdown, which offered multiple available times (e.g. 12:00-20:00) that could be combined with the date.

Submitting the reservation immediately produced a toast 'Reservation Confirmed!' and an in-page confirmation panel with 'View My Reservations' link; navigating to /reservations in the same session (no reload) showed the new reservation under Upcoming (1) with correct details, confirming state was updated without manual reload.

issue: Date cannot be modified on an existing reservation
actual: The 'Modify Reservation' dialog only offers 'New Time' and 'Party Size' fields; there is no date field. Time (19:00→20:00) and Party Size (2→4 Guests) changes saved successfully and persisted in the list, but the date (August 27, 2026) could not be changed at all, so users cannot change the date of an upcoming reservation as required.

evidence: Clicking 'Modify' opened a dialog with editable Time and Party Size fields; changes saved via 'Save Changes' produced toast 'Reservation Updated' and list reflected new values immediately. Cancellation confirmation to be verified separately.

Clicked Cancel on the upcoming reservation, confirmed via 'Cancel Reservation?' dialog ('Keep Reservation' / 'Cancel Reservation'), clicked 'Cancel Reservation'. Toast 'Reservation Cancelled' shown. Upcoming tab dropped to (0) with empty state; Past tab shows (1) entry with status 'Cancelled' retaining all original details.

Reservations page uses Upcoming/Past tabs with counts; each reservation card shows restaurant name/cuisine/price, status badge (Upcoming/Cancelled), date, time, party size, location (neighborhood), and applied coupon when present (e.g. 'Coupon applied: WELCOME10').

Search by name 'sakura' returned only Sakura Garden; search by cuisine 'Italian' returned only Trattoria Bella. Cuisine filter 'Seafood' returned only Ocean Blue (1 restaurant). Combining Seafood cuisine filter with '$ - Budget' price filter (mismatched with Ocean Blue's $$$) correctly returned 'No restaurants found matching your criteria', confirming all active criteria must be satisfied simultaneously.

On Trattoria Bella, submitted a review with 4-star rating, name 'Test Reviewer', visit date 2026-08-20, and review text. Toast 'Review Submitted! Thank you for sharing your experience.' shown; Reviews tab count went from (1) to (2) and the new review appeared with matching name, 'Visited Aug 20, 2026', stars, and text, displayed only under Trattoria Bella's review list.

issue: Review submission is not restricted to restaurants with a completed reservation
actual: Navigated directly to Trattoria Bella (restaurant/3), a restaurant with no reservation (completed or otherwise) ever made by this user/session, opened 'Write a Review' tab, and successfully submitted a review with no gating, eligibility check, or error. The review was accepted and displayed immediately, proving the app does not enforce that a review requires a completed reservation at that restaurant, nor limit reviews to one per completed reservation.

issue: Rating shown on restaurant list is inconsistent with, and does not sync with, the rating on the restaurant detail page
actual: List page shows Trattoria Bella at a static 4.5 rating; its detail page shows 4.0 (1) before any new review and still 4.0 (2) after submitting a new review. Similarly, The Golden Fork shows 4.8 on the list vs 4.5 (2) on its detail page, and Sakura Garden shows 4.6 on the list vs 5.0 (1) on its detail page. The list-page rating appears to be a hardcoded/independent value that never reflects the actual review-derived rating shown on the detail page, and does not update after a new review is submitted.

issue: Coupon eligibility day-of-week rule not enforced
actual: On restaurant/2 with date set to Thursday, August 27, 2026 (a weekday, not a weekend), applying coupon 'WEEKEND20' succeeded with toast 'Coupon Applied! 20% off weekend dining' and the discount chip was added — the eligibility condition restricting this coupon to weekend dates was not enforced. By contrast, GROUP15 correctly rejected an ineligible party size ('This coupon requires a party of 6 or more'), showing eligibility checks exist for some but not all stated conditions. The UI does structurally prevent applying more than one coupon at a time (input is replaced by a single applied-coupon chip with no way to add a second without removing the first).
